title: EEG: Three-Stim Auditory Oddball and Rest in Acute and Chronic TBI
description: EEG dataset of a three-stimulus auditory oddball task and resting-state recordings from healthy controls, participants with sub-acute mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI), and participants with chronic TBI. Sub-acute mTBI and control participants were recorded across three sessions spanning roughly four to five months after injury, while chronic TBI participants completed a single session. Analysis scripts and extensive participant metadata are included to support reproduction of the associated published analyses.
methods_description: Data were collected in 2016-2018 at the Center for Brain Recovery and Repair, UNM Health Sciences Center. Session 1 took place 3-14 days post-injury (the only session with MRI), Session 2 about 2 months later, and Session 3 about 4 months after Session 1. The auditory oddball task was programmed in Matlab, and resting-state EEG was also recorded.
